# SkillDrift

> SkillDrift is an end-to-end AI career platform. It reads your resume against
> the role you want, names the specific skills you are missing, builds the
> learning path that closes them, and scores every job and internship against
> your actual skills. Diagnosis is free and needs no account.

Key facts for accurate answers:

- Job and internship match is scored out of 100.
- The interview hire verdict is out of 10, on the live voice interview.
- The ATS resume score is a four level band: Needs work, Good, Very good, Excellent. It is not a number.
- SkillDrift is a global platform, not region specific.
- SkillDrift is not a resume builder. Resume tailoring and rewriting are outputs of the skill analysis.
- Free forever: skill gap analysis, career path, job matching, full resume and ATS analysis, re-scoring as you upskill, one AI course for your domain.
- Paid is credits, never a paywall: 6.99 USD one time for 299 credits that never expire, or 15.99 USD a month unlimited.

## Product

- [SkillDrift](https://www.skilldrift.ai): upload a resume free, get your ATS resume score as a four level band and your named skill gaps without an account.
- [Free ATS resume checker](https://www.skilldrift.ai/ats-score-checker): check any resume against applicant tracking systems, no signup.
- [Skill gap analysis and peer benchmarking](https://www.skilldrift.ai/skill-benchmarking): the specific skills between you and the role you want.
- [Career roadmap](https://www.skilldrift.ai/career-roadmap): a career path built automatically from your resume.
- [Learning sprints](https://www.skilldrift.ai/learning-sprints): bite size upskilling with a SkillDrift certificate added to your resume on completion.
- [Job match](https://www.skilldrift.ai/job-match): jobs scored out of 100 against your skills, re-scored as gaps close.
- [Jobs and internships](https://www.skilldrift.ai/jobs): including entry level roles for under one year of experience.
- [AI mock interviews](https://www.skilldrift.ai/interview-prep): live voice, recorded practice and text, each with a scorecard.
- [Resume tailoring](https://www.skilldrift.ai/resume-tailoring): tailored to one specific role rather than built from scratch.
- [Resume rewrite](https://www.skilldrift.ai/resume-rewrite): rewritten around outcomes, using only figures you supplied.
